$comment: Layer B selection cases for LEDGERX vs the real GnuCOBOL harness image (VSAM V1: INDEXED input, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, docs/vsam.md). The legacy side runs the indexed wrapper: the stdin seed becomes seed.txt, a harness loader materialises the INDEXED file with ACCESS DYNAMIC, then the module reads it - in RECORD KEY order, never seed order. FIRST=/LAST= put that ordering on the KV stream, so candidate B (which iterates the seed in the order given) is caught on every UNSORTED case while COUNT/TOTAL/FEE stay identical - order-independent sums cannot catch it. The sorted-seed case is the deliberate control: candidate B passes it, which is exactly why one case is never enough. Cases also cover both half-cent fee ties (total 1.00 -> 0.015 -> 0.02; 3.00 -> 0.045 -> 0.05), the GOLD tier boundary from both sides (5000.00 STD / 5000.01 GOLD), an empty file (COUNT 0, FIRST/LAST spaces), and the PIC capacity maximum.
